title: Western – Premium Tobacco 60ml
description:
Western – Premium Tobacco 60ml
Introducing ‘Western,’ the ultimate vape juice for enthusiasts craving the authentic taste of premium tobacco. Immerse yourself in a bold yet smooth blend, capturing the essence of aged tobacco leaves. Elevate your vaping experience with the distinguished flavor of ‘Western,’ a true homage to the classic charm of Old West tobacco. Savor the richness with every inhale, and let this meticulously crafted vape juice transport you to the heart of tradition.
60ml Bottle
0mg Strength
PG30/VG70
